servers.relayDocumentsWhat: Documents through lgrai.app: a server has no reader of its own, so the PDFs you import there are sent to lgrai.app, which takes their text out and, for a document its parser cannot read, has an AI model draft it. The PDF and its text pass through lgrai.app (the text to the model); only the answer is kept, for two days. Off by default at the Control link level.

pin.title: Till PIN
pin.description: Sign in at this server's tills with your operator code and a PIN, even when the internet is down.
pin.rule: 6 to 12 digits, not one digit repeated or a run such as 123456.
pin.passwordRequired: Sign in with your password to set a PIN.

onprem.title: Servers in your shops
onprem.description: These organizations run LGR on a server in the shop. When the shop's internet is down, you sign in to it with a local password, or at a till with your operator code and a PIN. Set them here ahead of time: the server receives them sealed, and lgrai.app keeps only what checks them.
onprem.ended: Ended by a password change or a sign-out everywhere: set it again.
onprem.passwordRule: At least 12 characters, and not your lgrai.app password.
onprem.saved: Saved. The server receives it within a minute while it is online.
onprem.sameAsGlobal: Choose a local password different from your lgrai.app password.
onprem.ownPasswordRequired: First choose a password of your own (above): the one you have was set for you.
onprem.noOperatorCode: You have no operator code in this organization, so a PIN would sign you in nowhere.
onprem.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again later.

account.manageOn: This server is linked to lgrai.app. Your name, email and password are changed there, and reach this server within a minute.
